Methodology & tooling

These projects are not built ad hoc. A shared library of agent-agnostic session prompts carries every one of them through the same specification-driven lifecycle — onboard, resume, derive a worklist, loop through it, log the work, review, hand over, and close. Each stage is a discrete, gated prompt, so work is planned and structured into a backlog and an ordered worklist before any code is written, and validated against the project's own gates before it lands.

The workflow is self-documenting and safeguarded by design. Every project keeps a single-source backlog, append-only implementation logs, and versioned session-notes handovers, so any engineer — or agent — can resume it cold. Every change moves through a branch and pull request that is never auto-merged; portfolio-wide runs open with a read-only workspace-safety preflight and pause at owner checkpoints. A machine-readable registry, shared templates, and a validation-gate cascade keep the showcases above consistent.
